emi.title: The Adhara EMI scheme
emi.subtitle: No bank. No credit check. No surprises.
emi.whyNoBankBody: A bank loan needs a credit history that most first-time riders don't have. Adhara carries that risk instead: you pay us monthly, and your vehicle is released for delivery once you cross the eligibility mark. Nothing is reported to a credit bureau, either way.

grievance.title: Grievance Redressal
grievance.intro: Under the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, every e-commerce entity must publish a Grievance Officer's name and contact details, along with the timeline for acknowledging and resolving a complaint. This page is that publication.
grievance.officerPending: A named Grievance Officer has not yet been appointed. This page publishes the mechanism ahead of that appointment so the process is never the missing piece.
grievance.ackSla: Acknowledgement within 48 hours of a grievance being raised.
grievance.resolutionSla: Resolution within 30 days, per the E-Commerce Rules — sooner wherever possible.

cookiePolicy.title: Cookie Policy
cookiePolicy.intro: This policy explains what cookies and similar technologies this site uses, and the choices you have under India's Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act.
cookiePolicy.whatBody: A cookie is a small file a site stores in your browser to remember something between visits — that you're logged in, which language you prefer, or that you've already seen a banner.
cookiePolicy.essential: Essential — session, locale and security cookies. The site does not function without these.
cookiePolicy.analytics: Analytics — not yet active. Section 6 of the design spec gates this on a GA4 property being provisioned.
cookiePolicy.marketing: Marketing — not yet active. Nothing on this site currently sets an advertising or retargeting cookie.
cookiePolicy.controlBody: Most browsers let you block or delete cookies in their settings. Blocking essential cookies may keep parts of the site — the language switcher and your EMI calculator selections — from working correctly.
cookiePolicy.reviewNotice: This is a development draft pending legal review before publication.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Statement
accessibility.intro: Adhara Energy wants every rider to be able to research, compare and enrol without a barrier the site itself put there.
accessibility.standardBody: WCAG 2.1 Level AA across every page type, verified with automated axe scans and manual keyboard and screen-reader testing.
accessibility.featureContrast: Colour choices verified for contrast, including the CTA accent against its background.
accessibility.featureKeyboard: Every interactive element — including the language switcher and colour picker — is reachable and operable by keyboard alone.
accessibility.featureMotion: Every animation respects prefers-reduced-motion and a constrained-network (Save-Data) signal.
accessibility.featureFocus: A visible, high-contrast focus indicator on every focusable element.
accessibility.feedbackTitle: Tell us where we fell short
accessibility.feedbackBody: If you hit a barrier anywhere on this site, we want to know — email us and we'll treat it as a bug, not a suggestion.

exchange.title: Exchange your petrol vehicle
exchange.intro: Trade in your existing petrol two-wheeler and the exchange value comes straight off what you owe under the Adhara scheme — no separate sale, no separate buyer to find.
exchange.step1: Tell us your vehicle's make, model and year below.
exchange.step2: A dealer inspects it at delivery and confirms the exchange value.
exchange.step3: That value is adjusted against your first EMI payment.
exchange.noteBody: The exchange value shown at enquiry is an estimate. The confirmed figure depends on the vehicle's condition at physical inspection.
